source_protocol.direct_supervision: route3_v2data_query_prepare.py placement/label_case: associate 256-grid source candidate with its GT 512 centre point, project into the target, require matching deeper peeled surface and ray support; take target fNNN-peeled-color.npz whole pixel at integer projected coordinates. No first_visible_other_frame in target colour. C uses analytic material/UV texture lookup.
source_protocol.actual_Query: src/light_candidate_fusion.py: two heads, frozen q/softmax weights, fused world point, source-frame reprojection then bilinear RGB plus bounded learned residual. Count all contributors with positive RGB weights. Dominant results use the highest effective RGB weight per retained head; weighted results sum the entire effective mixture.
source_protocol.original_substitute: Stage 3a hidden_parents: first_visible_other_frame and nearest whole-pixel RGB in new B dev. Legacy S0 uses the archived same-frame peeled EXR oracle, as in E0.
source_protocol.Query_purity: GT anchor is the surface at the dominant source candidate's original centre pixel. The exact four bilinear taps in each actual RGB source are weighted by their 4x4 occupancy of that surface. Purity is spatial coverage of that identity, not correctness of the inferred hidden surface.
source_protocol.predicted: For every actual E-H2@2k source pixel, purity = 2*abs(w_back_eff-.5), interpolated at the same four taps. Query geometry, source slots, O1 and per-head opacity are frozen. Drop unreliable RGB weights and renormalize the original mixture on survivors; keep the original residual. A head without admissible colour is omitted so F2 receives the residual transmittance.
source_protocol.S1_S2: Measure 4x4 fixed subpixel casts per actual pixel. S1 uses highest strictly positive occupancy among point-visible frames, ties use the earliest listed source. S2 uses linear RGB channelwise median for all positive occupancy and thresholds .5, .9, .99. Empty support goes to F2. For S3 f030 require matching object and axial depth to the centre peeled surface, with max(.01 m, 0.5%) tolerance. Uncovered parents are left to F2.
source_protocol.stratification: Rank hidden colour-parent purity by greatest compositing weight across K64, at 1e-6 visibility tolerance. At each threshold record recoverable if any baseline hidden contribution in a qualifying bin is visible, otherwise unrecoverable. Ground-truth purity strata are held fixed across Query variants. Separate point-level purity and image-level radiance.
source_protocol.perceptual: Support-weighted 64x64 full fixed-grid Alex LPIPS patches in display RGB. Direct distances are to each family's original S0 or Query; paired LPIPS differences also compare those methods to Cycles.
source_protocol.paired: Pool PSNR by SSE/(3*pixels); scene deltas use the same frame support; report population standard deviation and signed scene counts. S3 comparison subsets f030.
source_protocol.anchors: Only f030 uses centre peel for representative RGB error and S3. The .99 cutoff controls the fixed figures only; all requested thresholds are kept in numbers.
source_protocol.optics: G uses GT P2 nominal subject focus and P uses each geometry's own focus, both evaluate original masks. Focus shift uses K=25.4 px per inverse metre.

definitions.recoverable: nominal-focus GT depth band intersected with any of 16 recoverable off-axis first intersections
definitions.hidden: any of the 16 off-axis rays hits a surface hidden in the centre view
definitions.actual_compositing: Historical steps retain parent counts and crop coordinates, not per-pixel placed Gaussian hit maps or the randomly drawn aperture offsets. The pixel figures are geometric hits, and parent counts retain their separate units.
definitions.fstop: f/1.4 uses the archived K16. f/2 uses the same deterministic pupil and saved mesh, with no training or rendered model inference.
